title: Figma: Foundations · Layouts built, but not finished

owner_note.text: The Foundations · Layouts page has 7 layouts, each placed at 400, 1000 and 1920 wide with the same cards, text and buttons. The Figma tool limit stopped me before two things: the dark-ground row, and screenshots of 6 of the 7 rows (only Split 1:1 is checked, and it looks clean). The cards' title band also shows white on gray. All three are listed in kit/foundations.md, to pick up after the limit resets.
